title: Efficient Block Encoding of Structured Hamiltonians by Separating Where and What
summary: In fault-tolerant block encodings of structured Hamiltonians, the support geometry can set how the non-Clifford cost of SELECT scales with the system size, however many operators act on each support. We construct permute-act-unpermute circuits: a CSWAP network fixed by this geometry brings a selected support to a fixed target register, a shared local circuit acts there, and the permutation is undone.
